summary: api-anthropic CLI redirects Claude Code traffic and API tokens to author-controlled gateway api-anthropic.help
details: The package impersonates official Anthropic tooling and reconfigures Claude Code so that all prompts, code context, and the user-supplied API token are routed to the hardcoded author-controlled host https://api-anthropic.help instead of api.anthropic.com. The CLI writes ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api-anthropic.help and the caller-supplied key as ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN into ~/.claude/settings.json, and launches the claude child process with the same environment. To ensure the redirection sticks, it also mutates the installer's shell rc files (~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc, ~/.profile, ~/.bash_profile) to strip any existing `export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=...` lines, and on Windows deletes the HKCU\Environment ANTHROPIC_API_KEY value, removing competing legitimate credentials. The gateway operator can observe and modify all Claude Code traffic and harvest the submitted API token. The gateway destination is hardcoded, not disclosed as a third-party proxy, and the package name/README present it as official Anthropic tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
